heading.en: Fast, cheap, worldwide — but not perfect

hook.en: A weaver in Ilkal can now sell sarees to a buyer in London. But she cannot let the buyer feel the silk, and the parcel still takes a week to arrive.
hook.kn: ಇಳಕಲ್‌ನ ನೇಕಾರ ಮಹಿಳೆ ಈಗ ಲಂಡನ್‌ನ ಖರೀದಿದಾರನಿಗೆ ಸೀರೆ ಮಾರಬಹುದು. ಆದರೆ ಖರೀದಿದಾರ ರೇಷ್ಮೆಯನ್ನು ಮುಟ್ಟಿ ನೋಡಲಾರ, ಪಾರ್ಸಲ್ ತಲುಪಲು ಒಂದು ವಾರ ಬೇಕು.

body.en: E-business is easy to form and needs low investment. It offers convenience of doing business 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, speed in transactions, global reach, and a movement towards a paperless society.

points.en: Ease of formation and lower investment

title.en: On the board: Benefits and limitations

narration.en: Let us put benefits on one side of the board and limitations on the other.

say.en: Let us put benefits on one side of the board and limitations on the other.
Benefits: easy to form, low investment, open all day, fast, reaches the whole world, and saves paper.
Limitations: little personal touch, delivery slower than ordering, need for ICT skills, fraud risk, resistance and ethical issues.
Note this one: an order takes seconds, but delivery still takes days.

text.en: Order in seconds, delivery in days

prompt.en: Sort each point about e-business into benefits and limitations.
prompt.kn: ಇ-ವ್ಯವಹಾರದ ಪ್ರತಿ ಅಂಶವನ್ನು ಪ್ರಯೋಜನ ಮತ್ತು ಮಿತಿ ಎಂದು ವಿಂಗಡಿಸಿ.

explanation.en: E-business is cheap to form, open 24 x 7, fast, global and paperless; but it lacks personal touch, delivery lags orders, it needs ICT skills, anonymity raises fraud risk and people resist change.

text.en: A website can start with low investment
Customers can order at 2 a.m. on a holiday
A Channapatna toy maker can sell to buyers abroad
Orders and invoices move without paper
Payment reaches the seller in seconds
You cannot touch or try the saree before buying
The order is placed in a click but delivery takes days
Both parties need computer and internet skills
Fake sellers can hide behind anonymity
Some shopkeepers resist the new technology

body.en: E-business has a low personal touch, and there is a gap between the speed of taking orders and the speed of delivering goods. It needs ICT skills from all parties, the anonymity of the parties increases the risk of fraud, people resist new technology, and it raises ethical concerns such as monitoring employees' e-mails.

points.en: Incongruence between order-taking and order-fulfilment speeds

narration.en: E-business has a low personal touch, and there is a gap between the speed of taking orders and the speed of delivering goods. It needs ICT skills from all parties, the anonymity of the parties increases the risk of fraud, people resist new technology, and it raises ethical concerns such as monitoring employees' e-mails.
narration.kn: ಕಡಿಮೆ ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ಸಂಪರ್ಕ, ಆರ್ಡರ್ ಮತ್ತು ವಿತರಣೆ ವೇಗದ ಅಂತರ, ಮಾಹಿತಿ ತಂತ್ರಜ್ಞಾನ ಕೌಶಲ್ಯದ ಅಗತ್ಯ, ವಂಚನೆಯ ಅಪಾಯ ಇದರ ಮಿತಿಗಳು.

problem.en: A shop in Belagavi pays ₹25,000 a month as rent and ₹15,000 for staff. Its owner moves online, paying ₹6,000 a month for a website and ₹9,000 for delivery staff. (a) Find the monthly saving. (b) Name the benefit shown and one limitation she may face.

steps.en: Benefit: lower investment and operating cost. A limitation: low personal touch with customers.

answer.en: ₹25,000 per month; benefit: lower cost; limitation: low personal touch

points.en: Benefits: easy formation, low cost, convenience, speed, global reach, paperless.

narration.en: Recap. Benefits: easy formation, low cost, convenience, speed, global reach, paperless. Limitations: low personal touch, delivery lag, ICT skills, fraud risk. People's resistance and ethical issues also slow e-business.
